thread:
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary deploy blocked: security/vuln-scan reported a new HIGH severity transitive finding on image redwood/service-api:canary-2026-03-20. Scan ID: scan-7f9c.
deploy-bot: Details: CVE-2026-0001 in package fastnet v1.2.3 (transitive via lib-http). Fix available in fastnet v1.2.4.

maria: :eyes: pinging @security — is this exploitable at runtime for our use-case?
jonathan: how many canary instances are affected? can we reduce canary footprint and still validate?
ashley: quick note — the vulnerable package is only used in the metrics collector path. I think runtime exposure is limited but needs confirmation.
security: We saw this as a remote DoS in certain configurations. From initial look, our invocation path shouldn't trigger it, but we need verification. Can you paste the scanner fragment?
maria: scanner snippet:
```
vuln: CVE-2026-0001
package: fastnet
installed: 1.2.3
fixed_in: 1.2.4
path: /app/vendor/lib-http/fastnet
exploitability: remote
severity: HIGH
```
jonathan: option A: pin base image to previous digest (sha256:aaa111) that doesn't include the transitive update. Option B: block canary and wait for rebuild with fastnet 1.2.4.
ashley: Option A buys time but increases drift from main. We can reduce canary to 3 pods and turn on strict runtime checks + alerting. If any anomalies, auto-rollback.
security: We can approve a temporary canary if these conditions are met: 1) pin to digest or rebuild with patched fastnet within 24h, 2) reduce canary to <=3 pods, 3) enable anomaly alerts + increase log retention for 48h, 4) sign-off recorded in the release ticket.
legal-bot: Any license changes with fastnet 1.2.4? I scanned — no new obligations. No legal blockers.
maria: deploy-bot, can you show the deploy command and the policy-exemption flow?
deploy-bot: To run with pin override (timeboxed):
```
redwood deploy canary --image redwood/service-api@sha256:aaa111 --scale 3 --timebox 2h --owner maria
redwood policy exemption request --thread 2188881234 --expires 24h --reason "timeboxed canary with monitoring, patch follow-up"
```
jonathan: I'll open a patch PR to bump fastnet to 1.2.4 and schedule CI rebuild — target within 6 hours.
ashley: I'll enable anomaly alerts: latency, error-rate, CPU spike, and set auto-rollback at error-rate > 3% for 5m.
security: I'll add sign-off to the ticket once the monitoring hooks are confirmed. If any alert fires we rollback immediately.
maria: decision: allow timeboxed canary with the conditions above. Action items: jonathan (patch PR), ashley (monitoring + auto-rollback), security (final sign-off), deploy-bot (create exemption request). I'll document sign-off in the release ticket and update release notes: "Canary allowed under monitored exemption for CVE-2026-0001; patch in progress." :memo: :shipit:
